Sentence: The Frosting Swamp is way too scary. Good thing you spotted it early, or we would've fallen right in.
But we still got some sugar stains on us. Wanna wash up?
Thank you. I feel much more relaxed.
Here, let me help you dry off. Once you're rested up, get ready to head out.
Oh no, the monsters followed the aroma of the tea snacks here!
Don't worry, I'll drive them away.
Leave it to me.
Whatever stands in our way, I'll wash it all away.
Woof Woof Dan, the path to the treasure is packed with monsters. Any way to make them behave?
Hmm... I just need to use some of my real skills.
That makes things a lot easier! Just what I'd expect from you!
Now, just keep moving forward.
Finally, a rest stop! Let me sort out the luggage.
No problem, I trust your taste!
I want to bring this... and I want to bring that too!
Stop it! The backpack is getting way too heavy!
We rarely get a chance to relax on our adventures! Let me take a group photo of everyone to remember this!
Squeeze in, everyone! We all need to fit in the frame!
Don't worry, not a single person will be left out!
*click* All done! ...Wait, why are your eyes closed!?
My nose was a little itchy, so I yawned.
Oh well, I'll take a perfect picture of you next time!
Gotta look lively for our second adventure group photo, too!
My nose feels a little itchy again...
No way! You can't just waste my film.
Hey, this shot turned out really well! Awesome!
Of course! I am super photogenic when I actually try!
It's here! A treasure chest that spits out different treasures depending on the passcode you enter!
Passcode? Let me try this... "Three of a kind, two pair..."
Woof Woof Dan has joined the tea break.
...And suddenly, I'm teleported right next to you.
Now that the Trailblaze trio is gathered here, there ain't nothing to fear anymore!
Off we go!
It's rare we get a chance to take a break. Care for a cup of coffee?
Uh, how about... telling me the ingredients of this coffee first?
I've prepared an even richer selection of coffee. Take your pick!
D—Do I really have to pick a drink?
I've prepared a lucky coffee menu. Interested in giving it a try?
Will I really be that lucky?
The second special menu is also ready. Today's coffee actually glows!
That doesn't sound like normal coffee anymore.
Meow! There's abyssal whale phosphor in Sparkling Coffee. Even the emblem is glowing right along with it.
But my life has dimmed a little.
Coffee mixed with purple cheese. Rumor has it that its aroma will attract dependable companions!
Feels like they'd just turn tail and run!
Brewed using an ancient recipe from Planet Screwllum, Screws Coffee has a robust, hard-hitting flavor and is always a crowd-pleaser!
My teeth might not be that tough...
Wisdom Fruit Coffee. Word has it that anyone who drinks this coffee goes away saying, "You live and you learn."
That just means they'll never try it again!
Hm... Seems like I've lost the recipe for this cup of coffee. Even I don't know what the next sip will taste like.
How did you even make this cup then!? With sheer inspiration?
Roller skates, don't fail me now!
The recipe for this coffee... Huh? Why are you running off?
My intuition tells me I absolutely shouldn't drink this inky black stuff!
*gulp* Ack! Why is there a coin in the coffee!?
Congratulations! According to the traditions of a certain world, eating a coin is a symbol of good luck!
Sparkling Coffee! New and upgraded! Doesn't it look even more sparkly?
That just means more strange ingredients went into it!
This gleaming golden cup of coffee was made using precious canned golden flying fish.
Sounds expensive and hard to swallow...
Mmm, this flavor... Planet Screwllum's traditional grinding techniques are truly fascinating.
So, why are there equipment pieces in the coffee?
There's another review for Wisdom Fruit Coffee going around: You live and you never learn.
Are you on a caffeine high, or just stuttering?
How about we just treat this coffee with the missing recipe like a blind box and drink up?
A blind box... Feels like I'd be more startled than surprised.
Don't be afraid. The coffee only looks so dark colored because I added dark chocolate...
I'm not listening! I'm not listening!
Did you get a taste? It's Lucky Coin Coffee, specially brewed just for you like always~
You can't exactly call it good luck if you're putting a lucky coin in every cup of coffee!
Lucky Glowing Coffee makes a flashy entrance, and Emblems are drawn in by its good fortune.
This good fortune is a bit of a hot potato.
Lucky Purple Coffee. Companions and good fortune, served right to your table.
It'd be even better if the good fortune consumes a little less HP.
Lucky Screws Coffee. Your equipment is tightened by luck, too.
That sounds even more dangerous than coffee.
Lucky Hard-Knocks Coffee. Even setbacks serve up valuable experience.
I guess this is what taking an L tastes like.
Lucky Coffee Mystery Box. Today's surprise should be even bolder.
As long as you're not bold enough to outdrink me.
This drink... is actually drinkable? Wait, it even tastes good?
Oops... Sorry, I put in the wrong ingredient. Let me make you a fresh one, alright?
I'll pass!
Meow? Running off so fast... Guess you don't want that coffee anymore.
This is the Trailblazer's intuition!
Meow? Running off so fast... Guess you don't want that coffee anymore.
Sure did run off fast this time.
The second round of Lucky Glowing Coffee is so bright it practically screams at you to drink it.
It's screaming so brightly, I can barely keep my eyes open.
Lucky Golden Coffee! This cup's gold content is absolutely off the charts.
It's so high, I bet even the cups could be sold for cash.
Lucky Screws Coffee. Equipment inspiration and caffeine will kick in together.
I'll try not to screw up my inspiration while sipping.
Lucky Hard-Knocks Coffee, so bitter it keeps you wide awake, helping you learn even faster.
This cup of coffee is excellent at converting pain into experience.
Round two of the Lucky Coffee Mystery Box. The answer is hidden at the bottom of the cup.
I'll mentally prepare myself before drinking it, then.
This cup is pretty good too. Don't tell me it's another pleasant accident?
I'm willing to make a normal cup of coffee every now and then.
Meow? They sped off so quickly... Is this special coffee really that scary?
(All that's left are three pairs of speedy shoes)

All that's left are three pairs of speedy shoes.
After fighting for so long, I could really use a good rest...
I can go scout ahead. In the meantime, treat yourself to a seven-day weekend.
Dove, make sure you come back on time this time.
I'm heading out right away. I definitely won't flake this time.
Pretty sure you said that last time, too.
There are too many monsters... I can't hold out much longer...
I'll fly over to scout ahead and map out an easy route.
I'm leaving it to you! Stay safe during takeoff and landing!
Don't worry, I'll be back in the time it takes for a tea break.
There's not enough food! The afternoon tea prepared for the break just isn't enough, waaaah!
Get some more rest. I'll go look for supplies elsewhere.
Don't worry, I'll flap my wings as hard as I can and get the job done.
Turns out, birds fly to find food easily.
There are always supplies before a battle, but why are there so few?
If that's not enough to eat, I'll go look somewhere else.
My dove bro, sorry to tire out your wings.
Well, your stomach is growling. Wait for me.
I wish the others could be here with me too...
Hehe, I'll grant your wish.
Recite the spell I taught you. Close your eyes, open them... and boom! A bunny appears!
Now, I am...
I get it! You're just like the real thing!
I want to be the main character for once! I don't want to be chased by monsters!
Easy. I'll use the system to slap some plot armor on you.
You've been powered up. Go for it, protagonist.
It's not the Baseball Raccoon taking the stage, but the Galactic Baseballer!
I found a backdoor for a segment of enemy data.
What weird form are you turning the enemy into this time?
Subsequent Combat Nodes have been connected to the Trotter transformation program.
Hope they don't run too fast.
What an exhilarating adventure... If only it had been a little easier.
Hey, there's a golden finger hidden under the tea table. Wanna give it a try?
Don't get too reckless with it. It's not exactly standard procedure, after all.
Put on some gloves and no one will ever know!
Raccoon, I just uncovered the truth of the world. I realized we're all stuck inside a system called Currency Wars...
Shh, shh... Keep talking nonsense and you'll get kicked out.
Don't worry, I'm just taking a lil' advantage of the system.
Flight, Stealth, Invulnerability, Aimbot... Be careful not to get banned.
The sooner you use it, the sooner you enjoy it.
My friends, I'll remember how heroic you all looked in battle for the rest of my life!

The only flaw is that it's too perfect! I'd expect nothing less from you!
These assignments are from a bunch of cakes with legs, and these are from a bunch of worms with cavities.
People even come to you for help on the Snackfroster?
Well, I'm a detective, after all. The pay isn't half bad. Wanna give it a shot?
Assignment accepted. Let's go find a really tough Encounter.
Get Plot Armor to three stars, and consider this job done.
Come back and report once you've saved up enough Gold Coins. Don't go spending them all on the way!
Refresh the Store a few more times, and an opportunity will pop up on its own.
Staying healthy is also part of the assignment. Don't push yourself too hard.
Pressing on despite low HP... I'll give you points for guts.
Reach the right level, and assignments will naturally come to you.
It's okay if it's not perfect. Just leave your mark.
Getting consecutive Perfect Clears sounds like a great way to prove your skills.
I've brought some tougher assignments this time. Take your time choosing.
Will the pay be better, too?
Of course, risk and reward are always proportional. But don't let the size of the payout tempt you. Knowing your limits is what matters most.
Another Encounter Challenge. The old-fashioned way is still the best test of strength.
Two 3-star characters taking the stage? Now that's a good view.
A hundred Gold Coins sounds like a lot, but you should be able to save up that much.
Keep refreshing. The real opportunity is always hidden in the next attempt.
Keeping your HP above <unbreak>90%</unbreak> is the only way to comfortably complete an assignment.
The more critical the HP threshold, the more it reveals your judgment.
Once we hit Level <unbreak>10</unbreak>, this assignment is in the bag.
Missing a Perfect Clear still has value, as long as you can survive until the end.
Four Perfect Clears in a row. That'll look great on a resume.
